en.topic_title: Zhu Rongji, trailblazing ex-premier who transformed China’s economy, dead at 97
en.topic_summary:
Zhu Rongji, China’s former premier who died on Wednesday aged 97, championed free-market policies and delivered far-reaching economic reforms during his five years at the helm.



Former Chinese premier Zhu Rongji. File photo: Wikicommons.



Rumoured to be descended from Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming dynasty, Zhu was born in the central city of Changsha in 1928 into a China riven by civil war.



Zhu studied electrical engineering at Beijing’s elite Tsinghua Univer
